description: This Python source file implements a 'ParallelPipeline' class for concurrent frame processing in a media or data pipeline system. It manages multiple sub-pipelines, handles lifecycle frames (StartFrame, EndFrame, CancelFrame), and coordinates frame flow among the parallel branches. The class includes initialization, setup, processing, and cleanup methods specific to parallel frame processing workflows.

classes.name: ParallelPipeline
classes.description: A pipeline class that manages multiple sub-pipelines processing frames concurrently, with synchronization for lifecycle frames and frame flow coordination.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args)
methods.description: Initializes the ParallelPipeline with a variable number of processor lists, creating sub-pipelines with associated sources and sinks.

methods.name: processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-processors (sub-pipelines) contained within this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: List["FrameProcessor"] entry_processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of entry processors (sub-pipelines) which act as initial processors in this compound processor.

methods.name: List[FrameProcessor] processors_with_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects and returns processors across all sub-pipelines that support metrics collection.

methods.name: setup(self, setup: FrameProcessorSetup)
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up the parallel pipeline and all sub-pipelines with given configuration.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously cleans up resources used by the parallel pipeline and its sub-pipelines.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a given frame in all sub-pipelines concurrently, with handling for lifecycle frames for synchronization.

methods.name: _parallel_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the pipeline after checking if its ID has been seen, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _pipeline_sink_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles pushing frames from sub-pipelines to synchronize on lifecycle frames and forward them appropriately.
